Title: Vihaan and the Family

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Pihu - 8 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Savitri - 69 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Vihaan stands by the road. Anjali stands near him.]

Vihaan: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Vihaan: "Yes, of course."

[Vihaan gets off the school bus.]

Vihaan (happily): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Anjali and Pihu stand near him.]

Anjali: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan jumps with joy.]

Pihu: "Yes, of course."

[Vihaan gives Mother a flower.]

Anjali: "Really?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Anjali and Pihu stand near him.]

Vihaan: "So, here we are!"

[Vihaan takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Vihaan: "Oh wow!"

[Vihaan munches on an apple.]

Vihaan: "One more time!"

[Vihaan sips hot tea from a cup.]

Vihaan: "I really enjoyed today."
